notes: t_d95b8c13: the boot release install leaves the tenant one boot away from `400 Invalid Host header`. Two ends are fixed in the installer. (1) The tenant config now carries a `dashboard:` managed block whose `public_url` is the same host as `webapp.public_url` — the fallback Hermes's Host/Origin check reads when the Webapp listener did not declare its own (hermes_cli/web_server_boundary._dashboard_public_hosts) — and `--self-test` fails if either block stops naming it. (2) `ensure_systemd_services` starts `odile-agent` even when the optional `odile-access-report` oneshot fails, and restarts it when any file the gateway reads at start changed (config, .env, unit, skin), not only when a unit file did: on 2026-11-13 the report failed at 49.7 s and the abort left the listener the boot had started with, so every public Host answered 400 for five hours. The boot half (deploy/image/odile-release-setup.sh) now passes `--i-have-copied-it` (the installer's recovery gate exited 4 on a machine with no TTY, measured 2026-11-13T10:29:14Z) and `ODILE_RELEASE_PUBLIC_URL`, so a forced re-run keeps the demo host the owner declared. release/manifest.json is -6's fresh-root document with only installer_sha256 re-derived by tools/recut_release.py, so this is a surgical re-cut, not a root rebuild; the skills artifact, the vendor pin and the meter-free rows are unchanged. The id is -8: -7 is t_ab95ec2a's (odile-help first person) and -6 is t_afb081be's; the live cut at this cut's measurement was 2026.11.14-8 (0c53a722…, 1,356,516 bytes).
